messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "do not use anti-diarrhea medicine unless doctor instructs"
set: ["do not use anti-diarrhea medicine unless doctor instructs", "avoid taking aspirin unless doctor instructs", "do not stop unless doctor tells you to", "do not stop taking unless doctor tells you to", "do not use a second device unless you are told to", "do not inject leftover medicine", "do not change dose or stop unless doctor tells you to", "do not keep leftover medicine", "do not use if frozen", "do this unless your doctor tells you otherwise", "do not use more than one dose in a 24-hour period unless your doctor tells you to", "do not use a kitchen spoon", "do not use if particles present", "do not save for later use", "do not use extra medicine to make up the missed dose", "do not sell or give away medicine"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
